newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to take measures to rebuild fish stocks.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to take measures to rebuild fish stocks.

text.p: Argentine Agriculture Secretary Felipe Sola on Tuesday announced a range of measures to rebuild fish stocks in the country's territorial waters in the South Atlantic.

The measures will include stricter control of the size of hake caught, and an increase in both air and sea patrols to ensure that boats are not fishing illegally, Sola said, according to a statement issued by his office.
Sola said overfishing had significantly reduced stocks of many fish species, including sea salmon and hake.

"Stocks of young fish allow us to predict that today's crisis can be overcome," Sola said. But he added that "if no effective program is adopted (stocks) will begin to collapse with graver and longer-lasting consequences."
